title: galium anglicum var. divaricatum
intro: Galium anglicum var. divaricatum, commonly known as the English bedstraw or divaricate bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Galium anglicum var. divaricatum include its ability to stimulate the nervous system, improve circulation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
